maya: Quick scorecard snapshot for Prism-9B bring-up — ran fp16 / int8 / int6 passes on our consumer-chat slice. Putting raw numbers here for ops/product to decide routing thresholds. Link to full artifacts: https://redwood.internal/bench/prism9b/1830009999 :eyes:

bench-bot: AUTO: Completed microbench run (id: pb-1830). Summary attached.

oliver: Can you call out tail latency? last time int6 had weird 99p spikes on long conversations.

maya: Sure — high-level: int6 wins on cost (~38% cheaper vs fp16), int8 is middle (~22% cheaper). Quality: int6 shows minor degradation on long-form summarization (3pt drop on ROUGE-L), but chat-turn accuracy (GTN) is ~parity for <512 token prompts. 99p latency: fp16 420ms, int8 480ms, int6 620ms (long tail on >1024 tokens).

sam: That's inline with our previous reports. Do we have unit-econ numbers (cost per 1M tokens) and token throughput?

maya: Yep — paste of the quick table from the bench output: 
```
mode    | $/1M tokens | median latency | 99p latency | throughput (tokens/s)
fp16    | $34.5       | 120ms          | 420ms       | 8200
int8    | $26.9       | 140ms          | 480ms       | 7600
int6    | $21.4       | 160ms          | 620ms       | 7200
```
Note: cost numbers include GPU amortized + infra overhead for Dedicated pool.

jess: For product/GTN, what's the recommendation? Hybrid routing? fallback to fp16 on regression?

maya: Proposal: hybrid routing policy + quality gate. Rough rules: 
- Short/medium prompts (<512 tokens): default to int6.
- Long-running or high-fidelity routes (>512 tokens OR summary tasks): route to int8 by default; if quality checks fail then fp16.
- Canary %: start at 20% user traffic on int6 for short prompts, run 24h signal checks vs control.
- Auto-fallback: if GTN signal delta > 1.5% (or ROUGE-L drop >2.5 on eval slices) then divert to int8/fp16.

oliver: What about caching / KV reuse? Could reduce int6 tail since many long requests reuse prefixes.

maya: Good call — enable prefix KV caching for any session with >1 turn; we saw ~12% latency improvement on int6 when KV hit rate >60%. Add to config: `kv_cache_threshold = 1` turns, `kv_prefetch = true`.

sam: For canary plan I'll own metric definitions + A/B. I can set up a light-weight eval harness: 10k synthetic long prompts, 10k short chat turns. @oliver can you own infra config (autoscaler + KV) and run the int6 pack on Dedicated?

jess: I'll add this to the model scorecard and GTN handoff doc, set product readiness flag to "monitoring". Assign owners: sam -> quality metrics, oliver -> infra ops, maya -> eval artifacts + final rec.

bench-bot: QUEUED: Canary job (pb-canary-1830) created by sam. Expected run time ~6h. Results will post in this thread. :gear:

maya: TL;DR: int6 looks very compelling for short chat workload (big $ savings). For long-form we keep int8 as primary and fp16 for critical quality lanes. Start canary at 20%, KV caching on, run 24h, then reconvene with scorecard delta. :rocket:
